name: Sky Tower
intro: Longer gaps ahead! Run to the edge, then jump.
Shiny gems wait on top of the tall tower!
start_hint: Run to the edge and tap A for a long jump!
idle_hint: Run to the edge and jump. Head up!

hints.text: Jump high to grab the floating gem!
Narrow steps! Line up straight, then hop up.
Too tall to jump? Climb it like stairs!
Great view! Now leap down toward the flag.
